name: Luffy's Favorite Meat on the Bone
description: Juicy chicken drumsticks wrapped around a savory boiled egg and glazed with a sweet soy sauce.
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Push the chicken meat down each drumstick to expose the bone.
Season the ground chicken, then mix it with the panko and beaten egg.
Wrap each boiled egg in the chicken mixture and press it firmly around a drumstick.
Roast for 25 minutes. Brush with soy sauce, honey, and ginger, then roast for 10 minutes more.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Chill the wrapped drumsticks for 15 minutes before roasting if the mixture feels loose.
nutrition: Approximately 520 calories, 45g protein, 19g carbohydrates, and 28g fat per serving.

name: Gin's Takeout Stir-Fry
description: A fast, filling noodle stir-fry with pork, crisp vegetables, and a savory-sweet sauce.
instructions: Whisk together the soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, ketchup, and brown sugar.
Heat one tablespoon oil in a wok and brown the pork. Transfer it to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, cabbage, carrot, and onion; stir-fry until just tender.
Add the noodles, pork, and sauce. Toss over high heat until glossy and hot.
Divide among bowls and serve immediately.
notes: A handful of bean sprouts or sliced mushrooms can be added with the cabbage.
nutrition: Approximately 460 calories, 25g protein, 55g carbohydrates, and 16g fat per serving.

name: Kokoro's Curry Rice
description: A comforting Japanese-style beef curry loaded with potatoes and carrots and served over steamed rice.
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef chuck, cut into cubes
instructions: Heat the oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef in batches.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic; cook until fragrant.
Return the beef to the pot with the carrots, potatoes, and stock.
Simmer, partially covered, for 35 minutes or until the beef is tender.
Turn off the heat, stir in the curry roux, then simmer gently for 10 minutes until thick.
Serve alongside steamed rice.
notes: The curry tastes even better the next day. Add a splash of stock when reheating.
nutrition: Approximately 610 calories, 31g protein, 76g carbohydrates, and 20g fat per serving.

name: Ladies' Never-Before-Seen Takoyaki
description: Crisp-edged, custardy octopus dumplings finished with tangy sauce, mayonnaise, and bonito flakes.
instructions: Whisk the flour, eggs, dashi, and soy sauce into a thin batter.
Heat and generously oil a takoyaki pan.
Fill each well with batter, then add octopus, scallions, and pickled ginger.
As the edges set, turn each piece a quarter turn with skewers. Keep turning until round and browned.
Top with takoyaki sauce, mayonnaise, bonito flakes, and aonori.
notes: Keep the pan well oiled and do not worry about spilled batter; tuck it into the wells as you turn each piece.
nutrition: Approximately 290 calories, 14g protein, 39g carbohydrates, and 9g fat per 6-piece serving.

name: Mock Town Cherry Pie
description: A classic lattice-topped pie with a bright cherry filling and a crisp, buttery crust.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F and fit one crust into a 9-inch pie plate.
Toss the cherries with sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, vanilla, and almond extract.
Fill the crust, dot with butter, and cover with a lattice made from the second crust.
Brush with egg wash and bake for 20 minutes.
Reduce the heat to 375°F and bake for 35 minutes more.
Cool for at least 1 hour before slicing.
notes: Place the pie on a foil-lined sheet pan to catch any bubbling filling.
nutrition: Approximately 410 calories, 4g protein, 64g carbohydrates, and 17g fat per slice.

name: Gan Fall's Spiced Pumpkin Juice
description: A creamy pumpkin drink with apple, orange, warming spices, and just enough maple sweetness.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until completely smooth.
For a warm drink, heat gently in a saucepan without boiling.
For a cold drink, chill for 1 hour and serve over ice.
Stir before pouring and garnish with cinnamon.
notes: Use unsweetened pumpkin purée, not pumpkin pie filling.
nutrition: Approximately 150 calories, 2g protein, 37g carbohydrates, and 1g fat per serving.

name: Fruit Macedonia of Amends
description: A colorful fruit salad tossed in a light citrus-mint syrup for an easy galley dessert.
instructions: Place all prepared fruit in a large serving bowl.
Whisk the honey and lime juice until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the fruit and fold gently to combine.
Chill for 30 minutes, then add the mint just before serving.
notes: Add bananas only at serving time so they do not brown or soften.
nutrition: Approximately 170 calories, 2g protein, 43g carbohydrates, and less than 1g fat per serving.

name: Sea King Penne Gorgonzola
description: Penne in a rich gorgonzola cream sauce balanced with spinach, lemon, and toasted walnuts.
instructions: Cook the penne in well-salted water until al dente, reserving one cup of pasta water.
Melt the butter in a skillet and cook the shallot until soft.
Add the cream and simmer for 3 minutes. Stir in the gorgonzola until smooth.
Add the pasta and spinach, tossing until the spinach wilts.
Loosen with pasta water as needed, then finish with lemon zest and walnuts.
notes: Use a mild, creamy gorgonzola dolce for a balanced sauce.
nutrition: Approximately 720 calories, 24g protein, 75g carbohydrates, and 38g fat per serving.
